route_title: Control Axis: 16-Layer ZnSe/ZnS Dual-Band Filter on Ge
compilation_rationale: Bounded route compiles 16 fixed alternating ZnS/ZnSe layers on Ge. Quarter-wave initial thickness (~760 nm at 7000 nm central wavelength) assumed with broad 300–10000 nm bounds per explicit instruction. Constraint tolerance reduced by 10% noted. Two wavelength-band targets enforce stopband rejection and passband transmission via mean T constraints. Coherent smatrix solver applied.
